biggest_catch: You must be a Con Edison customer with central air conditioning and an eligible Wi-Fi thermostat — and you can't double-dip if you're already in Con Edison's Smart Usage Rewards. The $85 arrives 6–8 weeks after enrollment, and the extra $25/year only starts in year three.
catches: Must be a Con Edison residential customer with central air conditioning.
Your thermostat must be an eligible Wi-Fi model (Honeywell Total Connect Comfort, Honeywell Home, Sensi, or Amazon).
You cannot be enrolled in Con Edison's Smart Usage Rewards at the same time.
The $85 rebate arrives 6–8 weeks after enrollment is complete — not instant.
The $25/year retention incentive only starts in your third year and requires participating in 50%+ of event hours over the first three years.

c1.evidence: Con Edison is the regulated electric utility for NYC and Westchester; program page is on coned.com.

c2.evidence: Official Con Edison Bring-Your-Own-Thermostat page states: $85 rebate per enrolled thermostat (up to 12), paid within 6–8 weeks; $25/year retention incentive from the third year with 50%+ event-hour participation.

c4.evidence: Official page states the rebate is paid within 6–8 weeks after enrollment is complete.

eligibility: Con Edison residential customer with central air conditioning and an eligible Wi-Fi thermostat (Honeywell Total Connect Comfort, Honeywell Home, Sensi, or Amazon). Not enrolled in Smart Usage Rewards.
notes: Verified from the official Con Edison smart thermostat program page on 2026-09-23. Distinct from R0782 (Con Edison SmartCharge NY for EV charging) — different provider program. Framed as a rebate/savings, not income.
payout_quote: Claim an $85 rebate when you enroll your eligible smart thermostat — up to 12 devices. Rebate paid within 6–8 weeks; earn $25/year retention incentive from your third year with 50%+ event-hour participation.

s1.note: Con Edison customer; central AC; eligible Wi-Fi thermostat; not in Smart Usage Rewards.

s2.note: No fee; peak-event adjustments disclosed; opt-out available.

s3.note: Rebate within 6–8 weeks; retention incentive from year three.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: enroll thermostat, confirm, receive rebate.

steps: Confirm you're a Con Edison residential customer with central AC and an eligible Wi-Fi thermostat.
Enroll your thermostat in the Smart Thermostat Program on the Con Edison page.
Receive a confirmation email once enrollment is complete.
Your $85 rebate per thermostat arrives within 6–8 weeks.
Participate in peak demand events (May–September, 11am–11pm weekdays, small automatic adjustments you can override) to qualify for the $25/year retention incentive from year three.
timing: $85 rebate within 6–8 weeks of enrollment; $25/year retention incentive from the third year.
